parameters.prompt: The exact flying falcon in the reference hovers in place. It raises both wings high and draws its head back, then beats both wings down once hard while thrusting its head and open beak forward toward screen left, then closes the beak, raises the wings and returns to the exact original hovering pose and holds it. Its body stays at the same height and spot. Keep the same three-quarter left view, plumage, beak and wing shape. Exactly two wings and two legs. No flying across the frame, turning around, diving, second beat, extra limbs. Fixed camera, fixed size, pure uniform bright green #00FF00 background. The whole character stays inside the frame with wide margins at all times. Do not change any colours or tint. No motion blur, motion trails, afterimages, speed lines, smears, glow, glowing claws, coloured light, energy, liquid, spray, projectiles, feathers flying off, particles, dust, rocks, cracks, shadow or text.
